name: Laser Kombat
summary: Shoot all the tanks in a classic puzzle game.
author: sharkwouter
description:
Laser Kombat was a freeware puzzle game from the late 90s where you have to destroy all enemy tanks with the laser cannon on your tank without ever giving them a direct shot on you. If you get in a line without obstacles between you and an enemy you die, so you'll have to destroy them by using mirrors, explosives and by pushing them into the water.


Controls:
- Cross: Fire
- Circle: Undo the last move
- Square: Create a save point
- Triangle: Restore a save point
- Start: Restart the level
- L/R: Switch back and forth between levels
